decisions.reason: The general credibility-review instruction does not change the established reference basis, provisional-input policy, or assumption-disclosure requirement.
The source does not specify a currency, price-base-year, or currency-conversion decision and therefore does not alter or resolve this requirement.
Requiring credible final numbers does not change the existing requirement to demonstrate the necessity of availability-style payments.
The source provides no new return output or target and does not change the established equity IRR requirement.
The broad review instruction does not replace or revise the specified opex basis, scope, provisional status, or excluded Appendix input.
The source does not change the debt schedule or DSCR output requirements.
No financing parameter or structure is changed by the general instruction to review and improve the model.
The source does not revise the twelve-site network, authoritative site list, typologies, or treatment of missing site-level details.
The source does not change the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
The credibility instruction does not alter the specified CCA classes, depreciation treatment, tax-shield modeling, or return effects.
The source does not change the Case F and Case G definitions, availability-payment mechanism, or comparison requirement.
The source does not add, remove, or revise any revenue stream or the requirement to model the streams separately.
